title: Chargeback-Ratio Reserve on Pocketwire Business Profile Bank Payouts
content:
**Reserve standard of the risk team.** The chargeback-ratio reserve percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 8 percent when the number of chargebacks dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date is more than the tier's chargeback ratio review threshold percent of the number of sales dated in that window, 3 percent when it is more than half of that percentage but not more than it, and nothing otherwise. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Thresholds in figures

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chargeback ratio review threshold | 1.00% | 1.00% | 1.00% | 0.90% | 0.75% | 0.65% |
| Half of the threshold | 0.50% | 0.50% | 0.50% | 0.45% | 0.375% | 0.325% |

Columns are the tiers Pocketwire Business Starter to Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| Chargebacks as a percentage of sales in the rolling 3 months | Chargeback-ratio reserve percentage |
|---|---|
| more than the threshold | 8 percent |
| more than half the threshold, not more than the threshold | 3 percent |
| half the threshold or less | none |

## Points of judgement

**How is the ratio counted?** By number: the count of chargebacks against the count of sales, both dated in the same rolling 3 months.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, Pocketwire Business Starter, 200 sales in the window).** 3 chargebacks, 1.50%: 8 percent. 2 chargebacks, exactly 1.00%: 3 percent. 1 chargeback, exactly 0.50%: none.
